subject.title: fix(zai): add User-Agent header to endpoint detection probe

question: Should maintainers require live z.ai Coding Plan after-fix endpoint-detection proof for this PR before choosing it as the canonical landing path?
rationale: The actual failure depends on z.ai edge behavior and this PR currently shows only a local mock-server transcript, while multiple open PRs are competing for the same canonical issue.

options.title: Require live proof before landing
options.body: Ask for redacted live z.ai Coding Plan endpoint-detection output or provide a maintainer proof override, then land the best canonical PR and close the sibling PRs.

options.title: Accept existing mock proof
options.body: Treat the issue reporter's live before/after output plus this PR's local mock transcript as sufficient and proceed with maintainer-selected landing.

options.title: Use a sibling PR instead
options.body: Choose another open z.ai User-Agent PR as canonical if it has better proof or review state, then close this PR after that fix merges.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before landing
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live z.ai Coding Plan endpoint-detection output or provide a maintainer proof override, then land the best canonical PR and close the sibling PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the z.ai auto-detection feature history also points to steipete's earlier merged work.
